description: Na₂FeO₃ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmc2₁ space group. Na is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one FeO₄ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.33-2.68 Å. Fe is bonded to four O atoms to form FeO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent FeO₄ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent NaO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Fe-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.92 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to four equivalent Na and one Fe atom to form distorted ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids that share corners with four equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra, corners with five equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra, and edges with four equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Fe atoms to form ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent ONa₂Fe₂ tetrahedra, corners with eight equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids, and edges with two equivalent ONa₄Fe trigonal bipyramids.
